topic: Ukrainian infrastructure and Russian retaliation escalation

en.title: Putin pledges retaliation after Ukraine strikes on Russian oil plants, Lukashenko offers mediation talks
en.dek: Russian leader vows retaliation as Ukrainian attacks continue despite Trump requests; Belarus proposes direct talks between Kyiv and Moscow.
facts: Putin stated Ukraine has continued striking Russian oil plants despite requests from US President Donald Trump to stop
Putin described retaliation as inevitable following the attacks
Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko offered to fly to Moscow with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky for direct talks with Putin
Lukashenko also offered to act as a security guarantor for the Ukrainian leader
The strikes on Russian oil plants occurred despite US requests for cessation
Direct talks between Ukrainian and Russian leadership have been proposed by a third party
body: Russian President Vladimir Putin stated on Tuesday that Ukraine has continued to strike Russian oil plants despite requests from US President Donald Trump to stop, according to Al Jazeera and The Straits Times.
Putin described retaliation as inevitable following the attacks on Russian infrastructure, the same outlets reported.

Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko offered to fly to Moscow with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky to hold direct talks with Vladimir Putin, according to The Straits Times and The Kyiv Post.
Lukashenko also offered to act as a security guarantor for the Ukrainian leader during such talks, the same sources stated.
The proposals for direct talks come as Putin has vowed retaliation for Ukrainian strikes on Russian oil facilities.
The situation reflects an ongoing escalation in which Ukrainian attacks on Russian energy infrastructure have prompted Russian threats of retaliation.
en.context: Russian President Vladimir Putin and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky have been engaged in an escalating conflict involving strikes on energy infrastructure. US President Donald Trump has previously requested that Ukraine cease such attacks. Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko has positioned himself as a potential mediator between the two leaders.

en.headline: Putin pledges retaliation for Ukrainian attacks on oil refineries
en.body: Russian President Vladimir Putin stated on Tuesday that Ukraine has continued to strike Russian oil plants despite requests from US President Donald Trump to stop. According to Al Jazeera and The Straits Times, Putin described retaliation as inevitable.

it.headline: Putin promette ritorsioni per gli attacchi ucraini alle raffinerie di petrolio
it.body: Il presidente russo Vladimir Putin ha dichiarato martedì che l'Ucraina ha continuato a colpire gli impianti petroliferi russi nonostante le richieste del presidente statunitense Donald Trump di fermarsi. Secondo Al Jazeera e The Straits Times, Putin ha descritto la ritorsione come inevitabile.

fr.headline: Poutine promet des représailles après les attaques ukrainiennes contre des raffineries de pétrole
fr.body: Le président russe Vladimir Poutine a déclaré mardi que l'Ukraine continuait de frapper des installations pétrolières russes malgré les demandes du président américain Donald Trump de cesser ces actions. Selon Al Jazeera et The Straits Times, Poutine a qualifié les représailles d'inévitables.

es.headline: Putin promete represalias por los ataques ucranianos a refinerías de petróleo
es.body: El presidente ruso, Vladímir Putin, declaró el martes que Ucrania ha seguido atacando plantas petrolíferas rusas a pesar de las peticiones del presidente estadounidense, Donald Trump, para que cesaran. Según Al Jazeera y The Straits Times, Putin calificó las represalias como inevitables.

de.headline: Putin verspricht Vergeltung für ukrainische Angriffe auf Ölraffinerien
de.body: Russischer Präsident Wladimir Putin erklärte am Dienstag, dass die Ukraine trotz Bitten von US-Präsident Donald Trump, einzustellen, weiterhin russische Ölwerke angegriffen habe. Laut Al Jazeera und The Straits Times sei Vergeltung unvermeidlich, so Putin.

pt.headline: Putin promete retaliação por ataques ucranianos a refinarias de petróleo
pt.body: O Presidente russo Vladimir Putin afirmou na terça-feira que a Ucrânia continuou a atacar refinarias de petróleo russas, apesar dos pedidos do Presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, para que cessassem. Segundo a Al Jazeera e o The Straits Times, Putin descreveu a retaliação como inevitável.

zh.headline: 普京承诺对乌克兰攻击油炼厂进行报复
zh.body: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京周二表示，尽管美国总统唐纳德·特朗普要求停止，但乌克兰仍在袭击俄罗斯的石油工厂。据半岛电视台和海峡时报报道，普京称报复是不可避免的。

ja.headline: プーチン大統領、ウクライナによる石油精製所攻撃への報復を誓約
ja.body: ロシアのウラジーミル・プーチン大統領は火曜日、米国ドナルド・トランプ大統領からの停止要請にもかかわらず、ウクライナがロシアの石油プラントへの攻撃を続けていると述べた。アルジャジーラとストraitsタイムズによると、プーチン大統領は報復は避けられないものだと述べた。

ko.headline: 푸틴, 우크라이나의 정유 공장 공격에 대한 보복 약속
ko.body: 블라디미르 푸틴 러시아 대통령은 화요일에 미국 도널드 트럼프 대통령의 중단 요청에도 불구하고 우크라이나가 러시아 정유 시설을 계속 공격했다고 밝혔다. 알자지라와 스트레이츠 타임스에 따르면, 푸틴은 보복이 불가피하다고 설명했다.

en.headline: Belarusian President Lukashenko proposes joint talks with Zelensky and Putin
en.body: Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko offered to fly to Moscow with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky to hold direct talks with Vladimir Putin. According to The Straits Times and The Kyiv Post, Lukashenko also offered to act as a security guarantor for the Ukrainian leader.

it.headline: Il presidente bielorusso Lukashenko propone colloqui congiunti con Zelensky e Putin
it.body: Il presidente bielorusso Alexander Lukashenko si è offerto di volare a Mosca con il presidente ucraino Volodymyr Zelensky per tenere colloqui diretti con Vladimir Putin. Secondo The Straits Times e The Kyiv Post, Lukashenko si è anche offerto di agire come garante della sicurezza per il leader ucraino.

fr.headline: Le président biélorusse Loukachenko propose des pourparlers conjoints avec Zelensky et Poutine
fr.body: Le président biélorusse Alexandre Loukachenko a proposé de se rendre à Moscou avec le président ukrainien Volodymyr Zelensky pour mener des pourparlers directs avec Vladimir Poutine. Selon The Straits Times et The Kyiv Post, Loukachenko a également proposé d'agir en tant que garant de la sécurité du dirigeant ukrainien.

es.headline: El presidente bielorruso Lukashenko propone conversaciones conjuntas con Zelenski y Putin
es.body: El presidente bielorruso, Aleksandr Lukashenko, se ofreció a viajar a Moscú con el presidente ucraniano, Volodímir Zelenski, para mantener conversaciones directas con Vladímir Putin. Según The Straits Times y The Kyiv Post, Lukashenko también se ofreció a actuar como garante de seguridad para el líder ucraniano.

de.headline: Belarusischer Präsident Lukaschenko schlägt gemeinsame Gespräche mit Zelensky und Putin vor
de.body: Belarusischer Präsident Alexander Lukaschenko bot an, mit dem ukrainischen Präsidenten Wolodymyr Selenskyj nach Moskau zu fliegen, um direkte Gespräche mit Wladimir Putin zu führen. Laut The Straits Times und The Kyiv Post bot Lukaschenko sich auch als Sicherheitsgarant für den ukrainischen Führer an.

pt.headline: Presidente bielorrusso Lukashenko propõe conversações conjuntas com Zelensky e Putin
pt.body: O Presidente bielorrusso Alexander Lukashenko ofereceu-se para voar a Moscovo com o Presidente ucraniano Volodymyr Zelensky para realizar conversações diretas com Vladimir Putin. Segundo o The Straits Times e o The Kyiv Post, Lukashenko também se ofereceu para atuar como garante de segurança para o líder ucraniano.

zh.headline: 白俄罗斯总统卢卡申科提议与泽连斯基和普京举行联合会谈
zh.body: 白俄罗斯总统亚历山大·卢卡申科提议与乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基一同飞往莫斯科，与弗拉基米尔·普京举行直接会谈。据海峡时报和基辅邮报报道，卢卡申科还提议充当乌克兰领导人的安全担保人。

ja.headline: ルカシェンコ大統領、ゼレンスキー大統領とプーチン大統領との共同会談を提案
ja.body: ベラルーシのアレクサンドル・ルカシェンコ大統領は、ウクライナのウォロディミル・ゼレンスキー大統領と共にモスクワへ渡り、ウラジーミル・プーチン大統領と直接会談することを提案した。ストraitsタイムズとキーウ・ポストによると、ルカシェンコ大統領はゼレンスキー大統領の安全保障の保証人となることも申し出た。

ko.headline: 루카셴코 벨라루스 대통령, 젤렌스키 및 푸틴과의 공동 회담 제안
ko.body: 알렉산드르 루카셴코 벨라루스 대통령은 볼로디미르 젤렌스키 우크라이나 대통령과 함께 모스크바를 방문하여 블라디미르 푸틴과 직접 회담할 것을 제안했다. 스트레이츠 타임스와 키이우 포스트에 따르면, 루카셴코는 또한 우크라이나 지도자에 대한 안보 보증 역할을 하겠다고 제안했다.
